author: Kyle Jackson
title: Traders Sell Apple (AAPL) on Strength (AAPL)
text:
Tweet 
Investors sold shares of Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) on strength during trading hours on Thursday. $1,100.31 million flowed into the stock on the tick-up and $1,949.36 million flowed out of the stock on the tick-down, for a money net flow of $849.05 million out of the stock. Of all stocks tracked, Apple had the 0th highest net out-flow for the day. Apple traded up $1.30 for the day and closed at $167.78 
AAPL has been the subject of a number of research analyst reports. Rosenblatt Securities set a $180.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday, December 26th. Loop Capital reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Friday, December 22nd. BMO Capital Markets reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $199.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, December 20th. Citigroup reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $200.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, December 13th. Finally, KeyCorp reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $192.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, December 7th. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have assigned a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has assigned a strong buy rating to the company. Apple has an average rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $202.62. Get Apple alerts: 
The stock has a market capitalization of $851,317.94, a P/E ratio of 18.22, a PEG ratio of 1.27 and a beta of 1.19. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 EPS for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $3.82 by $0.07. The firm had revenue of $88.29 billion during the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $87.62 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 37.37% and a net margin of 21.13%. The firm’s quarterly revenue was up 12.7% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the business posted $3.36 EPS. analysts expect that Apple will post 11.37 earnings per share for the current year. 
In related news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction dated Friday, January 5th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total transaction of $2,733,733.98. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The transaction was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which is available at the SEC website . Company insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.

Finally, Certified Advisory Corp acquired a new stake in Apple in the 4th quarter worth about $3,158,000. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 61.35% of the company’s stock. Apple Company Profile 
Apple Inc (Apple) designs, manufactures and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players, and a variety of related software, services, peripherals, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. The Company’s products and services include iPhone, iPad, Mac, iPod, Apple TV, a portfolio of consumer and professional software applications, the iOS and OS X operating systems, iCloud, and a variety of accessory, service and support offerings.
